query: select player_id, max(player_display_name) as player_display_name, position_group, recent_team, season, count(*) as rows, count(distinct week) as distinct_weeks, sum(nullif(receptions,'')::numeric) as receptions, sum(nullif(receiving_yards,'')::numeric) as receiving_yards, sum(nullif(receiving_tds,'')::numeric) as receiving_tds, count(*) filter(where nullif(receptions,'') is null) as null_receptions, count(*) filter(where nullif(receiving_yards,'') is null) as null_receiving_yards, count(*) filter(where nullif(receiving_tds,'') is null) as null_receiving_tds from public.nflfastr_player_stats where season_type='REG' and position_group in ('TE','WR') and season between '1999' and '2024' group by player_id,position_group,recent_team,season order by season,recent_team,position_group,player_id
